note: Top navigation bar -- renders: Wikipedia logo, search box, main menu, user account controls (Donate/Log in/Sign up)
Table of contents -- renders: 'Contents' label, 'Hide' button, and section headings which are operator-defined navigation anchors
Page title bar -- renders: page title, language selector, and 'Add section' button
Left navigation tabs -- renders: 'Article' and 'Talk' tabs
Right navigation tabs -- renders: 'Read', 'Edit', 'View history' tabs and 'Tools' menu
Appearance settings -- renders: 'Appearance' label, 'Hide' button, and font size/width/theme options
Page subtitle -- renders: fixed text 'From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'
Content subtitle -- renders: 'Latest comment' label and link to the latest discussion (operator-defined navigation)
Category links -- renders: 'Categories' label and category names (operator-defined taxonomy)
Page footer -- renders: copyright info, license links, and site policy links (Privacy policy, About, Disclaimers, etc.)
